description: This file defines a thread-safe implementation of an observable pattern, providing mechanisms to add/remove observers, mark the observable as changed, and notify observers with optional arguments.

classes.name: Observable
classes.description: A thread-safe, non-subclassable class implementing the observable pattern, allowing observers to register and be notified of changes.

methods.name: Observable
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the observable object.

methods.name: Observable
methods.description: Copy constructor that clones the state and observers from an existing Observable.

methods.name: addObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer to the set of observers, if not already present.

methods.name: clearChanged
methods.description: Resets the changed flag to false.

methods.name: deleteObserver
methods.description: Removes a specific observer from the set.

methods.name: deleteObservers
methods.description: Removes all observers from the list.

methods.name: hasChanged
methods.description: Checks whether the observable has been marked as changed.

methods.name: notifyObservers
methods.description: Notifies all registered observers with a null argument.

methods.name: notifyObservers
methods.description: Notifies all registered observers with a specified argument.
